title: A new natural Cyperol A together with five known compounds from Cyperus rotundus L.: isolation, structure elucidation, DFT analysis, insecticidal and enzyme-inhibition activities and in silico study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11491-11502
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00505A, Paper
Open Access

Saqib Hussain Bangash, Muhammad Ibrahim, Akbar Ali, Chen-Yang Wei, Amjad Hussain, Moazama Riaz, Muhammad Fayyaz Ur Rehman, Faiz Ahmed, Rashad Al-Salahi, Wen-Wei Tang
One new natural benzaldehyde derivative (1), together with five known compounds, was isolated from the methanolic extract of the whole plant of Cyperus rotundus L., which is a globally distributed noxious weed.
